method: One current 1920x1080 desktop frame for PNG comparison; three iterations per case. Desktop pixel benchmarks capture independently. Only aggregate timings and sizes were retained; no screenshot pixels were saved.
interpretation: The spatially filtered probe selected compression for this desktop and reduced transfer size by about 93%. Compression itself cost more CPU. Direct DIB capture avoids a selected-bitmap GetDIBits call and an intermediate bitmap readback. These short, loaded-machine samples do not establish end-to-end latency or elimination of intermittent display-driver stalls.
scroll_regressions: Sparse text on white background advances by the actual 73 pixels
Blank overlap cannot establish scroll distance
Horizontal gradients retain vertical alignment evidence
Thirty small movements extend the image past the old 16-frame limit
Stored strips and preview preserve exact source pixels
Temporary native Enter/Escape commands are scoped to the active session
